name: server-round17-smoke
description: Smoke test of the round-17 chain (a local rehearsal): limited pytest (tests/server, the tests of the round 17 runner, hook and report, and the tests of the round 13 to 16 runner and report), the mux11 repro run, then smoke17-1bk: the GOMEA partners in miniature (configs/gomea/server-smoke17-1bk: BASE-TLS and BASE-TLS-100K of round 16, the same three manifests, old splits 1 and 2, 1,000 and 2,000 evaluations; 26 jobs), so the smoke needs no round 16 results; then 1bl in miniature on old split 1 (configs/gomea/server-smoke17-1bl-a: the same three manifests, arms, flags, keys and spec as 1bl, split 1 only, 1,000 and 2,000 evaluations, a wall cap of 300 s; the spec reads the partners of smoke17-1bk; 26 jobs). The smoke uses old splits 1 and 2, never splits 81-90, so it needs the datasets with splits 1-2 and the 26 partner summaries of smoke17-1bk. No extension. Then smoke17b. Uses its own state dir, so it never marks real steps done.
